guitar.modelsText: Magneto Eric Gales signature / Fender Stratocaster (played left-handed, strung upside-down)
guitar.notes: Eric Gales is known for his unusual left-handed-upside-down playing style; he has a Magneto signature model. Less universally iconic than top-tier blues legends, so medium confidence.

tone.target: wah-driven gritty fuzz lead with soulful sustain
tone.profile: wah-driven gritty fuzz lead with soulful sustain
tone.summary: A fuzzy, wah-enhanced signal chain using a Fuzz distortion, Wah filter, followed by the UK 45 amp model to achieve a classic, mid-forward blues sound with delay sustain.
corrections: Keep lead tone gritty, not smooth

rig.name: Eric Gales - I want my Crown - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide initial grit and boost the signal into the fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The target specifies 'fuzz over Tube Screamer', but Green OD provides a necessary pre-drive tone shaping before the main distortion block.

blocks.purpose: Generate the core fuzzy grit and sustain required for the lead tone.
Emphasize the wah-driven element and add vocal character.
Provide a classic, mid-forward British blues tone foundation.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is chosen for its punchy, articulate midrange, ideal for blues lead work.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the sound of a classic British cabinet to complement the UK 45 amp.
Slightly scoop the low end and boost the upper mids to enhance lead clarity.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical tone shaping after the main gain stages.

blocks.purpose: Add a touch of delay to enhance the perceived sustain and space.
blocks.gap: The target requires 'touch of delay' for sustain, making Digital Delay suitable without sounding overly ambient.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle room ambience to give the lead tone depth without muddying the grit.
blocks.gap: A small amount of Room reverb is used for natural space, avoiding excessive wash.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture the punchy, mid-forward character of classic blues lead work.

proposals.reason: Enhance the punchy, mid-forward character needed for blues lead.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the mids.
